services.desc: Host an unforgettable corporate event aboard our luxury yacht, with stunning views of the San Francisco Bay. Empress Events offers the ultimate venue for your next corporate event. Our luxury yacht provides a unique and impressive setting for meetings, team-building events, client gatherings, and more. With over 30 years of experience, our dedicated team ensures a seamless experience, from planning to execution. Enjoy breathtaking views of the San Francisco Bay Area while networking, celebrating, or strategizing with colleagues.
